about: What counts as success, as data. Add an entry to add a question; the backtest and the dashboard pick it up without code changes. Change an entry's key whenever you change its meaning, so old results are never compared with new ones.

game.label: A game below 5,000 players now reaches 5,000 within 24 hours
A game with at least 200 players now doubles its player count within 72 hours
A game at 5,000+ players now is still at 5,000+ seven days later

idea.label: A game first seen within 30 days of its creation reaches 5,000 players within 30 days of creation
A game first seen within 30 days of its creation reaches 20,000 players within 30 days of creation
